hero.headline: Bridal beauty, softly considered.
hero.text: Hair and makeup for brides in Leicester, Leicestershire and across the UK, created around your features, your dress and the way you want to feel when you walk in.
hero.imageAlt: Bride on her wedding morning with soft, polished makeup and styled hair

aboutIntro.heading: A calm pair of hands on the most photographed morning of your life
aboutIntro.text:
Beauty by Nam is a one-to-one service. You will talk to Nam from your first message to the final touch of hairspray, so nothing about your look is a surprise.

She works on the details that make a bride feel like herself: skin that still looks like skin, hair that holds through the speeches and a finish that photographs well.
aboutIntro.imageAlt: Nam, bridal hair and makeup artist, at work

servicesIntro.heading: Hair and makeup, for the day and the days around it
servicesIntro.text: Every booking is quoted individually, so you only pay for the time and services you actually need.

instagram.heading: Recent work, hand-picked
instagram.text: A curated selection of looks from @beautybynamm. For the latest posts, stories and behind-the-scenes, follow along on Instagram.

closingCta.heading: Tell me about your day
closingCta.text: Share your date, your venue and a little about the look you have in mind. Nam will reply personally, usually with a few questions and a tailored quote.
closingCta.imageAlt: Soft evening light on a bridal dressing table
